## English

This directory contains the BSD45 port glue (boot, monitor, syscall bridge) (standalone boot code).

`config.mk` records 19 source file(s) here: `alloc.c`, `bcopy.c`, `bzero.c`, `cat.c`, `close.c`, `copy.c`, `dev.c`, `disklabel.c`, `getfile.c`, `gets.c`, `ioctl.c`, `ls.c`, ....
